name: Apartlino TV
tagline: Ekran dobrodošlice za goste na televizoru u apartmanu
description: Gost uključi TV i vidi svoje ime, Wi-Fi, kućni red, vremensku prognozu i događaje u gradu, uz pokretanje Netflixa i YouTubea. Imena gostiju se popunjavaju sama iz rezervacijskih mailova. Besplatno za vlasnike.
audience: Iznajmljivači u BiH, Hrvatskoj i Srbiji

en.tagline: A welcome screen for guests on the apartment TV
en.description: Guests turn on the TV and see their name, the Wi-Fi password, house rules, the weather and events in town, plus one-tap Netflix and YouTube. Guest names fill in automatically from booking emails. Free for owners.
en.audience: Hosts in Bosnia, Croatia and Serbia

page.title: Apartlino TV — guest information screen for rentals
page.description: Guests turn on the TV and see their name, Wi-Fi, house rules, weather and city events. Names fill in automatically from reservation emails. Free.
page.h1: Apartlino TV — guests turn on the TV and it is all there
body: Guests ask the same questions every time: what is the Wi-Fi password, when is check-out, where can we eat. Apartlino TV puts the answers on the television home screen, so nobody has to message the host at midnight.
Guest names fill in automatically from Booking.com and Airbnb reservation emails — the host types nothing. Netflix and YouTube launch from the same screen. Free for apartment owners.
features: Guest name, Wi-Fi password, house rules and check-out time on the home screen
Weather and city events, for several cities
Netflix and YouTube launch straight from the screen
Names are read automatically from reservation emails
Runs on an Android TV box or a smart television

page.title: Apartlino TV — info ekran za goste apartmana
page.description: Gost uključi TV i vidi svoje ime, Wi-Fi, kućni red, prognozu i događaje u gradu. Imena se popunjavaju sama iz rezervacijskih mailova. Besplatno.
page.h1: Apartlino TV — gost uključi TV i sve piše na ekranu
body: Najviše pitanja gosta su uvijek ista: koja je Wi-Fi šifra, kad je odjava, gdje se jede. Apartlino TV ih stavi na početni ekran televizora, pa gost ne piše poruku u pola noći.
Imena gostiju se popunjavaju sama iz rezervacijskih mailova s Booking.coma i Airbnba — vlasnik ne upisuje ništa. Netflix i YouTube se pokreću s istog ekrana. Besplatno za vlasnike apartmana.
features: Ime gosta, Wi-Fi šifra, kućni red i vrijeme odjave na početnom ekranu
Vremenska prognoza i događaji u gradu, za više gradova
Netflix i YouTube se pokreću direktno s ekrana
Imena se čitaju sama iz rezervacijskih mailova
Radi na Android TV kutiji ili na pametnom televizoru
